scope: Windows UI Automation explicit focused-control capture and follow-up chat contract

design_basis.name: OmniParser
design_basis.adaptation: 保留 UI Automation/结构化目标优先，视觉模型只作为需要时的慢路径

design_basis.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
design_basis.adaptation: 系统可读选区只解决当前屏幕文本，项目事实与原因分析仍进入文档/图谱证据路由

design_basis.name: RAGFlow
design_basis.adaptation: 选区文本保持独立来源和 V# 可追溯引用，不与私有文献 E# 混淆

implementation.native_capture: Windows UIA TextPattern.GetSelection reads at most four selected ranges and 4000 characters only during explicit focused-control capture
implementation.privacy: password controls and unknown password state are redacted; control name and selected text remain separate fields
implementation.propagation: selected_text is carried through Tauri snapshot, workflow planning, frontend perception event, /chat schema, runtime event normalization, and interaction context
implementation.evidence: explicit UIA selected text becomes screen_text_selection evidence in the V# namespace with source_modality=ui_automation
implementation.routing: direct selected-text transformation bypasses document retrieval only when the query has no factual/comparison markers; factual questions still include the selected text in retrieval context

limitations: 现有 REAL-PILOT 数据中的 ui_selection 文本仍可能只是区域标签，不足以证明 UIA TextPattern 在真实应用中成功读取正文。
必须补采至少覆盖浏览器、Office/PDF 阅读器和桌面应用的真实选中文字 episode，并保留原始选区、应用、分辨率和人工真值后，才能评估改写准确率、错误绑定率和端到端延迟。
